description: Initializer: init.sh, memory files, MIT LICENSE, .env.example, secret scan hook
Injectable clock and the SQLite store in WAL mode, claims inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE
Job state machine as an explicit table, every transition tested, a crash in each state
Durable steps: ctx.step saves results, replay returns saved results and runs only the next step
Two submits with the same idempotency key create one job (Done means 5)
Outbox entries commit with the step, the dispatcher sends them with dedupe key store:job:step:index, and a dead list
Token buckets for rpm, rpd and tpm from TOML, kept in the store, retry-after and x-ratelimit headers, request log audit (Done means 4)
Retries by error class with full-jitter backoff, circuit breaker per provider, dead-letter table and requeue
Fake provider on 127.0.0.1 injecting 429, 500, timeouts, slow replies and dropped connections from a seed
SIGKILL the worker at random points in 200 runs: every job ends succeeded or dead, no finished step runs twice (Done means 2)
Chaos benchmark: zero duplicate side effects, no limit breaks, completion, wasted calls, p50 and p95 latency and throughput at three fault levels over 5 seeds (Done means 3, 4, 6)
Command with submit, work, dispatch, status, requeue, bench, killtest and readme
All tests pass offline, guarded by conftest (Done means 1)
README quality bar: sections in order, generated tables, CI badge, social preview, demo page, links checked
Study-later kit: WALKTHROUGH, INTERVIEW_QA with the interview points, DECISIONS
Release check and hand-off: RELEASE_CHECK, HUMAN_STEPS, COWORK_PROMPT, CHANGELOG with the release SHA
